entries.name: layer

entries.name: canvas_texture
entries.owner: gate 8: headless CanvasTexture shim (memory canvas-texture-headless-rid; STS2 criterion 5 pending approval)
entries.notes: a headless host's RenderingServer.canvas_texture_create returns RID() by default (dummy renderer); the opt-in GRC_HEADLESS_CANVAS_TEXTURE=synthesize shim is not used by any committed gate 6 fixture.

entries.name: DXT, BPTC and float texture payloads
entries.owner: gate 8, decided together with gate 7's receiver manifests
entries.notes: STS2 has 940 of 1451 textures in these formats; the options are carrying compressed payloads for receivers that advertise them, or a host-side CPU decode. Gate 6 adds nothing here.

payload deltas, atlas/mesh-region deltas, parameter deltas, hash-at-publish, lazy hashing, spill-to-disk, parallel fetches
entries.owner: the first optimization increment after gate 6, chosen from G6p's `optimizations` numbers (gate6-design.md D15)
entries.notes: measured offline by scripts/analyze-deltas.ts, not implemented; see the README "Gate 6 summary" for the measured whole-version-vs-delta figures.

entries.notes: support landed at gate 5.5; no gate 6 fixture has a receiver join after materials already exist, so late-join adoption is unexercised.

entries.name: two attached canvases at an equal (layer, sublayer)
entries.notes: the renderer breaks equal stacking keys by canvas RID (rv.h:125-130), which no receiver can reproduce; decoders accept and validate the shape (viewport-entry / canvas-stacking-tie-miss / -false, render-stream-6.md), but no committed gate 6 fixture produces it (gate6-design.md "As built (G6b)" 1: "No transaction of any capture carries a canvas-stacking-tie").

entries.name: degenerate 64x64 host (observe policy)
entries.owner: gate 8: STS2's host size policy (gate6-design.md D4)
entries.notes: root_size_policy observe keeps the 64x64 headless root (scene_tree.cpp:2034); no committed gate 6 fixture uses this policy, every one declares enforce-min-size or presentation:.

entries.name: Viewport.set_canvas_transform changed at runtime
entries.notes: calibrator 9 hooks viewport_set_global_canvas_transform and compares it with the arm-time stretch (gate6-design.md Q2); render-stream-6.md's golden-6 fixture exercises the wire shape, but no end-to-end gate 6 leg changes the root's global canvas transform at runtime.

entries.owner: gate 8: non-root Viewport/SubViewport census (typed since gate 0, never given a dedicated increment)

entries.owner: gate 7: several presentation sizes per session, receiver-advertised size negotiation

entries.name: presentation_size / font_oversampling / host_size_status declared
entries.notes: GRC_ROOT_SIZE=presentation:<W>x<H> makes the headless root window WxH so the engine itself computes the stretch transform, font oversampling and StyleBoxFlat feather (gate6-design.md D2).

entries.name: receiver at a different presentation size
entries.owner: gate 7: several presentation sizes per session, receiver-advertised size negotiation
entries.notes: one presentation scale per capture session (gate6-design.md D2); this is the typing, not the feature -- serving several viewer sizes from one session is gate 7's.

entries.name: several presentation sizes per capture session
entries.owner: post gate 7: one presentation size per session
entries.notes: Gate 7 kept one host evaluation per session; a receiver at another size types presentation-mismatch (Q4).

entries.name: snap-to-pixel replay
entries.notes: declared and typed, never replayed: the receiver does not apply snap_2d_transforms_to_pixel/_vertices_to_pixel.

entries.name: snap_2d declared at arm
entries.notes: no web-export leg replays the /1 evidence (capture-snap|snap-typed); the wire carries it as for native

entries.name: stretch.aspect other than "keep" at an unequal ratio
entries.notes: the wire's stretch.aspect enum accepts ignore/keep/keep_width/keep_height/expand; every committed gate 6 fixture uses keep at an equal aspect ratio (gate6-hd 1920x1080 <-> 960x540), so the other values are unexercised (Q8 example).

entries.name: stretch.mode = "viewport"
entries.notes: stretch mode viewport evaluates nothing scale-dependent on the host, but no committed fixture proves it, so the receiver would type it stretch-mode if it occurred (gate6-design.md D2, Deferred).

entries.name: stretch.scale_mode = "integer"
entries.notes: every committed gate 6 fixture uses scale_mode fractional (the default); integer is accepted by the wire schema but unexercised (Q8 example).

entries.name: delivery across a bandwidth- and latency-limited link
entries.notes: a runner-side token-bucket TCP proxy (gate6-design.md D12), not tc; loopback only.

entries.name: a receiver disk-cache budget with LRU eviction (G6s)
entries.owner: gate7-design.md D16: the browser HTTP cache cannot evict; D16 measures the profile's disk use instead
entries.notes: receiver.gd types a disk budget on the web (applied.json `unsupported`, name `cache`); the memory budget is honoured.

entries.name: render-stream/7 negotiated credit window (1, or 2 by default since G7wd)
entries.notes: Window 2 is the default (G7wd); window 1 is explicit and its g7-r list (late-poll, ack-on-receipt) passed in G7w2c's addendum.

entries.name: /7 hello token, HTTP token and Origin allowlist
GRC_LIVE_MAX_CONNECTIONS: two receivers at different rates
entries.notes: one snapshot copy per host frame serves every open connection.

entries.name: the host and receiver on separate machines
entries.notes: gate 6's constrained transport is a loopback proxy, not a real network path.

entries.name: page suspension (hidden, frozen), reload, close and WebGL context loss
entries.notes: Desktop suspensions are simulated (page-side rAF pause, G7u fork 2026-10-18); the real hidden/frozen rows need the g31 and are typed `unavailable` on the desktop (G7u e7c8235f passed them on the g31).

entries.name: presentation feedback (frame actually shown, not just applied)
entries.owner: post gate 7: no receiver reads presentation feedback
entries.notes: Q12: `presented` is `unavailable` for every receiver, the phones included (`content_update_hz` is the compositor's activation rate, never called presented).

entries.name: GRC_PUBLISH_FPS target rate, coalescing missed ticks
entries.notes: at 60/60 the achieved rate is phase-dependent on the credit RTT (memory rs-g6c-60-60-phase-lock); the mechanism itself (a due tick that holds credit, carrying the newest state) is supported.

entries.name: receiver memory/disk cache budgets with LRU eviction
entries.notes: never evicts a hash in the needed set; a 300 s soak keeps residency bounded (gate6-design.md Q7e).

entries.name: a 300-s live soak with bounded receiver memory
entries.notes: rss-bounded-renderer is report-only on the web export, typed known-shortfall (G7kr 099a92f9, owner G7kw2): the page renderer grows about 7-10 MB/min post-GC against Q10's 2 MiB/min (the engine's GL-id tables plus about 6 MB/min of PartitionAlloc no one-factor control explains). It is not cited as evidence; the other three bounds are.

entries.name: cold and warm startup to the first submitted frame
host-evaluated, host-rasterized glyph atlases
entries.notes: glyph pixels and antialiasing bands are 'undecided' only in the independent hand model (gate6-design.md D7); the receiver is still checked whole-frame, budget 0, against the rendered reference.

entries.name: RichTextLabel line height, scroll clamping and clip
entries.notes: 23px regular/bold line height, image line 64px, scroll clamped to the new maximum on text replacement (gate6-design.md "As built (G6a)" 7).

entries.name: RichTextLabel BBCode effects, TextEdit and IME composition
entries.owner: post-gate-6: a host-time contract like shader TIME (effects); gate 8's census (TextEdit/IME)
entries.notes: effects run on process time (gate6-design.md Q1f) and are kept out of every gate 6 fixture by construction.

entries.name: AnimationPlayer and Tween deterministic per-frame sampling
entries.notes: quarter-frame clocks (gate6-design.md D6) keep every sample a quarter frame from any key, loop end or rounding threshold.

entries.name: arm on first subscriber, disarm on last
entries.notes: gate 6's armed-idle arm measures what a permanently armed hook costs today (G6p).

entries.name: web export and GSW canvas receivers
entries.notes: The Godot 4.5.1 web export (web_dlink_nothreads, Rust core as a side module) under the pinned Chromium; its own legs only (D1).

entries.name: a receiver joining after items/canvases/textures/meshes/materials already exist
entries.owner: gate 8: late-join adoption pass (STS2: 46 pre-arm roots, 1302 items withheld; memories rs-sts2-shim-leg-findings, rs-unknown-item-skip)
entries.notes: gate 6's canvas-layer support is only the replay half; adoption of pre-arm layers is gate 8's.

entries.name: Light2D rendering: shadows, normal/specular maps, occluders
entries.owner: the handoff's later capabilities, unchanged from gate5_5-design.md and gate5-design.md "Deferred"
entries.notes: Light2D attachment itself is typed (material.unsupported via canvas-light); its rendering is not implemented at all.

entries.name: LineEdit focus box, selection and caret
entries.notes: one focus owner per viewport; deselect_on_focus_loss_enabled must be set false before the next LineEdit grabs focus (memory rs-g6h-hd-facts).

entries.name: ProgressBar per-frame value, text and fill width
entries.notes: redraws every frame (step 0.01); text int(ratio*100), fill round(ratio*(w-4)) (gate6-design.md "As built (G6a)" 4).

entries.name: a same-build repeat of the rendered reference
entries.notes: 0 mismatched pixels of every shot on gate6-scene and gate6-hd, both presentations (gate6-design.md "As built (G6a/G6h)").

entries.name: StyleBoxFlat antialiasing feather under canvas_items stretch
entries.notes: aa_size / scale, band still aa_size/2 + 1 screen px; 768 triangle arrays matched the gate 5g port with 0 ulp, needing none of the 2-ulp allowance (gate6-design.md "As built (G6b)" 6).

entries.name: Windows and macOS hosts/receivers
entries.owner: after gate 6, per the handoff's platform scope
entries.notes: every gate 6 fixture, capture and receiver run on Linux; nothing here has been tried on Windows or macOS.
